page.overview:
Who is Filson Bood?

Filson Bood was a salvager who worked in the Jagoth system.

Bood was salvaging with his droid Exoh in the Jagoth system when he found a shuttle owned by Atticus Cale. Investigating it, he discovered the corpse of the Jedi Master and called the Office of the Frontier to report it. When Temesh and his Pathfinder team arrived, they were told that Bood was a thief and under arrest. However, Talik and Morla were able to hack the Jagothian Dominion communications and discovered that Bood was actually employed by Petro Arglass.
